mapper.select: select * from lab_device where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
mapper.insert: insert into lab_device( lab_id, device_name, device_code, brand, model_no, quantity, available_quantity, status, purchase_date, remark, deleted ) values( #{labId}, #{deviceName}, #{deviceCode}, #{brand}, #{modelNo}, #{quantity}, #{availableQuantity}, #{status}, #{purchaseDate}, #{remark}, 0 )
mapper.update: update lab_device set lab_id = #{labId}, device_name = #{deviceName}, device_code = #{deviceCode}, brand = #{brand}, model_no = #{modelNo}, quantity = #{quantity}, available_quantity = #{availableQuantity}, status = #{status}, purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
update lab_device set deleted = 1 where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
